purpose: City-specific cadastral-source research; findings are limited to observed first-party evidence.
name: Halle (Saale)

queries.query: Halle (Saale) official cadastral map parcel viewer Flurstücke Saxony-Anhalt
queries.result: First-party Halle service documentation identifies the state Geobasis-Viewer as the public route for Liegenschaftskataster information, including parcel boundaries, and links to the Saxony-Anhalt geodata portal. The state portal documents free ALKIS parcel WFS access without personal data.

queries.query: Halle Saale amtliches Liegenschaftskataster Flurstück Viewer Sachsen-Anhalt
queries.result: Die amtliche Hallenser Dienstleistungsseite verweist für Flurstücksgrenzen und Kartendarstellung auf den Geobasis-Viewer des Landes Sachsen-Anhalt. Das Landesportal weist einen kostenfreien WFS für Flurstücke ohne personenbezogene Daten aus.

registryEvidence.custodian: Landesamt für Vermessung und Geoinformation Sachsen-Anhalt (LVermGeo), with Halle (Saale) directing users to the state Geobasis-Viewer
registryEvidence.scopeNote: The Halle city service is a local custodian/procedure reference; parcel geometry was obtained from the first-party state LVermGeo open-data WFS, not from a city-owned endpoint.
